    SCOUTING, EVALUATION & INVESTMENT

    Discover Our Expertise

    Our Vision

    We aim to scout for innovative solutions tailored to each market's needs and help governments, municipalities, high-tech parks, global accelerators, and the private sector attract relevant companies to launch products and establish market presence.

    With GVI's process and professionalism, we improve startups' conversion rates to secure funding and expand into global commercialization

    .      

    SCOUTING

    With years of experience, we have the capabilities and expertise to Scout and discover new and exciting Startups. At Gold Ventures Investment, we combine our insights, skills and knowledge of the Israeli Ecosystem to advise you and to help you reach the full potential of your investments. We’re proud to help shape and improve how our clients structure and manage their investments.

    EVALUATION

    Looking to understand which startups to invest in?

    Do you need Due Diligence services? Need help planning or executing your next project? Let us guide you. Any organization can move forward with small incremental changes, but building for the future in today’s rapidly evolving environment means taking bold chances and making insightful decisions.


    We operate with a team of 31 experts from various fields such as:

    AI, VR/AR, FinTech, Agri-tech, Blockchain, Life Science & Clean Energy.

    ​

    Our Experts assist investors in screening and evaluating the company's potential and in executing Due Diligence. We can make recommendations by identifying potential Startups to make an initial investment in order to pass an incubation plan as a preliminary stage towards a significant investment (via Gold Ventures Incubator).

    INVESTMENT

    Are you a company looking for Investments? Then we can help you find the best investment for you.

    With connections around the world, we can find the best deals for you in Israel and abroad. Whether you are an early-stage company or running for your A-Round, we can help you achieve your goals.
